name: Farkaslyuk (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Farkaslyuk: a shield of green, red and black with crossed hammers, a figure and a mining lamp, within a green wreath, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Farkaslyuk arms with wreath and scroll
